Marissa / Lauren / Neha / Rishi —

Forwarding an urgent complaint from Integro. They began a paid campaign and immediately ran into elevated 429s and higher latency. Customer says conversion impacted and is explicitly asking about account-level rate limits vs platform-wide problems.

Quick context: Integro is on a Dedicated plan (reserved pool) with a custom burst window and an agreed burst cap set in their policy. We rolled a pacing policy change last week to tighten burst allowances to reduce cost leakage for shared customers; that change may have been applied to Integro in error during a bulk config push at 02:30 UTC this morning.

Attachments: integro_sla_telemetry.csv (their sample)

Action requested: can eng/ops triage immediately and confirm whether the customer's burst quota/bucket was suppressed or misapplied? If so, we need a hotfix (temporary restore to previous policy) + plan for customer-facing communication.

I have cc'd Marissa (AM), Lauren (Product), Neha (SRE) and Rishi (Runtime) — please advise ETA. I will update the customer with next steps in ~30 minutes.

— Ben

- Confirm whether the Integro route was matched to a new global pacing policy or their Dedicated override.
- Check the policy rollout change log for any bulk push around 02:00–03:00 UTC.
- Pull token-level traces for 08:40–09:10 PST and an account-level quota/burst snapshot.

If this is a policy misapplication we should:
1) Temporarily restore the pre-change policy for Integro (don't apply to other customers yet).
2) Open a rollback for the bulk deployment and pin the rollout.
3) Prepare a short customer note that explains root cause and immediate mitigation.

Neha / Rishi — can you own triage and confirm ETA? Marissa / Ben — I'll prepare the customer note and loop in legal/sales ops if we need credits.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors during campaign window — urgent

Summary of findings (first 30m triage):
- We confirmed a policy change entry in the pacing-config repo: "tighten-burst-defaults-v2" deployed at 02:31:12 UTC (CI/CD audit id 8721).
- Integro's dedicated override was erroneously omitted from the rollout manifest because of a tag mismatch (customer-tag: integro-prod vs integro-prod-v1). As a result the global tightened policy replaced their dedicated override, reducing their burst allowance from 1.5x to 0.25x for short windows.
- Token-level traces for 08:48–08:55 PST show a rapid prefix of requests where the server returned 200s initially but then switched to 429s after the KV cache was stale and the new pacing layer enforced the lower burst cap. 95th latency climbed to 4.2s as queuing increased.

Immediate mitigation (we can execute now):
- Command: apply-temp-policy --account INTEG-2026 --policy restore-override-v1 --ttl 2h
- This will restore the prior override and rehydrate allowed bursts; expected customer-facing improvement within ~45s after reconfiguration and cache invalidation.
- We will also revert the rollout manifest and create a focused patch that excludes dedicated customers without exact tag match.

Next steps (post-mitigation):
- Full postmortem and config change gating (2 days)
- Customer credit recommendation: 25% of billed inference costs for the impacted 2-hour window, pending revenue impact data (Marissa / Sales ops to finalize)

I can run the temp command with ops privileges now if someone else authorizes.

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors during campaign window — urgent

Alex —

Thanks again for flagging this so quickly. Wanted to share what we've done and next steps:

What happened (short):
- A recent pacing policy change was unintentionally applied to Integro due to a tagging mismatch in our rollout manifest, which reduced the account's burst allowance and resulted in elevated 429s and increased latency during their campaign ramp.

Immediate actions taken:
- At 10:12 PST on 2026-08-02 we applied a temporary restore of Integro's previous dedicated override (Neha executed a temp policy patch). You should have seen success rates return to normal within a minute; our telemetry shows 429s dropping back to baseline and 95th latency recovering under 1.1s.
- We rolled back the bulk routing/pacing manifest and pinned the rollout.
- We created a targeted fix to avoid tag-mismatch regressions; gated deployment scheduled after validation.

Customer impact & remediation:
- We understand this impacted your campaign performance from ~08:50–10:12 PST. We recommend we work through actual revenue impact together; in the interim we will provision a 25% service credit for the affected window pending final review. Marissa / Sales ops will follow up with the credit paperwork.

Next steps (who does what):
- Marissa to send formal credit proposal and draft customer-facing postmortem (today).
- Lauren / Product to own the postmortem and policy gating plan (2 days).
- Neha / Runtime to complete change to rollout tooling and add tag validation (48h).

Apologies for the disruption — we take these incidents seriously and will share a clear RCA and the preventative steps soon. If you want a live walk-through of the telemetry we can schedule a short call; please let me know earliest availability.

Best —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
